review: Read the complete frozen seven-page proof and all eleven joined source pages. Independently rebuilt and rendered all seven pages; direct visual inspection found no missing formulas, clipping or unresolved references. The source page streams and extracted text are exact original-edition joins.

Checked the literal affine normalizer calculation, the square-class distinction and the transporter count. A quadratic PGL subfield class determines its Borel class, and the two outer exchanges force distinct classes; uniqueness is established for the fixed subgroup, not only for its isomorphism type.

Checked all affine covers: the nontrivial complement generates K, commutators place translation parts in V, maximality forces the original complement and two-transitivity is exactly scalar transitivity on V/K. The half-scalar group cannot be transitive on a nonzero K quotient.

Checked Frobenius descent pointwise on both subgroups, projective entry normalization, odd-degree determinant square classes and the trivial-centralizer argument in the explicitly restricted odd characteristics. The descent lemma proves uniqueness of a conjugate projective overgroup of each exceptional stabilizer.

Checked the three A5 small-field incidence counts, unique D30 overgroup and reduction to exponent2, odd-subfield exclusions and quadratic A4/S4 cases against the accepted common overgroup theorem. The accepted scalar and q9 components are reused explicitly, not reacquired as new results.

The missing affine families, corrected unordered counts and appendix auxiliary false PGL exclusion are qualified separately. Additional fixed-appendix p-versus2 denominator transcription errors were sent to the whole-source ledger author. Whole-original closure remains dependent on the complete individual ledgers.
